system.description:
Your bonded weapon is more than a tool — it is a partner, growing more attuned to you with every spell channelled through it.

  • Attuned Edge: Your bonded weapon counts as magical for the purpose of overcoming damage resistance, and you have advantage on checks to identify or recall lore about it or weapons like it. If the weapon is ever lost or destroyed, you may bond a replacement of the same type after a short ritual (1 hour, no cost) rather than waiting for a new weapon to find you.
